description: Source code for combat-related functions in the Unvanquished game, including damage handling, player death, destruction logging, and BP (build point) transfer mechanics.

methods.name: G_PlayerDie
methods.description: Handles player death, including logging, animations, respawn timing, and death effects.

methods.name: G_RewardAttackers
methods.description: Distributes rewards to entities that contributed damage or kills to the entity being destroyed.

methods.name: G_LogDestruction
methods.description: Logs destruction or deconstruction events of buildables.

methods.name: G_InitDamageLocations
methods.description: Initializes damage regions for different classes based on configuration files.

methods.name: G_CanDamage
methods.description: Checks if an inflictor can directly damage a target based on line-of-sight.

methods.name: G_SelectiveDamage
methods.description: Applies damage selectively based on team and other conditions.

methods.name: G_SelectiveRadiusDamage
methods.description: Applies radius damage selectively, considering team and line-of-sight.

methods.name: G_RadiusDamage
methods.description: Applies radius damage to entities within a specified radius.

methods.name: G_AnnounceStolenBP
methods.description: Announces build point theft events to players.

methods.name: TransferBPToEnemyTeam
methods.description: Transfers build points between teams based on damage and destruction events.
